summary: Phase 3A.1 Unified Support Inbox + Phase 5A Marketing Spend + Founder Command Centre MVP — tested on web. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass (admin 2-step auth, inbox dedupe/filters/search/pagination/leak-check, marketing CRUD + void + CSV export + RBAC, command-centre shape). Frontend: all three pages load after 2-step admin login and render correctly — Unified Inbox shows 46 tickets / 31 enquiries / 0 legacy (WAY-0045 and WAY-0046 appear under source=ticket, Legacy tab is empty as expected), Marketing Spend creates expense + campaign and summary totals update in AUD, Command Centre renders 6 blocks + data-source health strip + drill-down 'View' links. One non-blocking React console warning found (duplicate `enquiry-null` key in inbox table caused by existing contact_requests rows that lack `id`).

ui_bugs.issue: React warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key, enquiry-null'. The row key is `${r.source}-${r.id}` (line 156 of AdminSupportInbox.jsx) but some contact_requests documents in the DB have id=null, so every such enquiry row collides. Rendering still works but React may drop/duplicate rows and it floods the console (observed ~70 warnings in one page load). Recommend falling back to a stable index-based key or including `created_at` in the key: `key={`${r.source}-${r.id || r.created_at || idx}`}`.

action_items: AdminSupportInbox.jsx line 156: make the row key defensive against missing ids (append `r.created_at` or the array index) to stop the duplicate-key console warnings for enquiry rows that have null id. Minor only — functionality is fine.
critical_code_review_comments: Inbox endpoint correctly strips `_id` and never selects body/internal_notes/messages — the leak-check test asserts this and passes.
Legacy dedupe works: WAY-0045 and WAY-0046 appear as source=ticket only (legacy count=0, backend confirmed via DB query via API).
Marketing endpoints enforce require_super_or_ops; unauthenticated GETs return 401/403 as verified.
Marketing amounts are strictly AUD (summary cards display A$ prefix; backend currency constant = 'AUD', no FX in code).
Command Centre blocks each carry source + last_updated + status with an 'empty' honest state; data_source_health lists the ad-platforms integration as 'not_connected' (correct).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Three new admin pages verified: /admin/support-inbox, /admin/marketing-spend, /admin/command-centre. All API surfaces at /api/admin/{support/inbox, marketing/*, command-centre/summary} are gated behind 2-step admin auth. The inbox dedupes migrated legacy tickets via sup_tickets.migrated_from.legacy_id — current state: 46 sup_tickets, 31 contact_requests, 0 remaining legacy. The React duplicate-key warning in AdminSupportInbox is cosmetic and should be fixed by main agent in one line.
rca of the issue: Duplicate React key cause: multiple contact_requests documents in Mongo lack an `id` field. The backend returns `id: None` for them, and the frontend renders rows with key `enquiry-null` for each one. Fix the client-side key (one-line change) rather than backfilling DB data.
